changelog:
jianding-system 1.0.5

- Added detailed boundary handling for all脚本流程 steps, specifying user guidance for missing photos, file type errors, insufficient or excessive images, failed uploads, verification code issues, and more.
- Clarified multi-modal vs text-only description collection, with explicit user confirmation and correction steps before submission.
- Introduced automatic retry logic in scripts/submit.py for network errors (exponential backoff, max 3 attempts), with clear distinction from business logic errors.
- Updated authentication, error fallback, and post-script reminder procedures, ensuring precise user prompts and fallback to the WeChat H5 pathway when needed.
- Added data timeliness disclaimer regarding platform statistics and user guidance for information verification.
